A task in such a project is refused with a message saying so. A repair (for example creating the copy at join time) is not built; I recorded the gap in \\u0060docs/scope.md\\u0060.\\n  - A solution epic counts as Closed as soon as any copy the node holds is closed. That treats a close still replicating as closed.\\n  - \\u0060epic list\\u0060 and \\u0060epic show\\u0060 reference a solution epic by the last 8 characters of its key; \\u0060ResolveGroupAsync\\u0060 matches a key\\u0027s start or end.\\n  - \\u0060solution add\\u0060 runs the link-time copy step, but a freshly minted solution has no epics, so it stages nothing today. I kept it because the criteria name \\u0060add\\u0060.\\n  - The closeout guard matches linked tasks by primary external reference only, like the existing cross-task gate. An issue held only as a task\\u0027s secondary reference is not seen.\\n  - The closeout guard acts on the GitHub issue close path only, because Jira is never closed at closeout.\\n- **Tests:** All new store-backed cases are in the existing \\u0060SolutionWriterTests\\u0060 class, so no container was added. The same seams are covered by the store-backed tests, and I only ran \\u0060--help\\u0060 for the new text.\\n- **Left undone:**\\n  - Nothing closes a solution epic automatically.\\n  - There is no \\u0060epic reopen\\u0060.\\n  - \\u0060solution close\\u0060 does not touch epics.\\n  - \\u0060task revise\\u0060 is Draft-only. The shared-issue refusal\\u0027s remedy text says so rather than trying to move the holder back to Draft.\\n- **Self-review:** Round one found no defects.
